title: Iterating to a Pose: Damped Least Squares for Any Arm, Why It Needs the Damping, and What It Finds Instead of Eight

artifact.note: numerical inverse kinematics by damped least squares: the error of a pose as the difference of the places and the rotation vector of the target rotation times the transpose of the present one (with the half turn handled), the step J transpose times the solution of (J J transpose plus lambda squared) y = error with a 6 by 6 solve, a limit on the largest joint step, an optional clamp to the joint limits, and a result that says whether it converged, in how many steps, and how far it was left
